correctness.rationale: Two independently specified predicates agree on all 4096 vertex subsets. The full 722-face complex is matched by a deterministic 358-pair elementary matching and its directed 2748-cover Hasse graph is acyclic by an exhaustive 722-vertex topological sort. Precisely one critical vertex and five critical four-simplices give an integral wedge of five four-spheres by discrete Morse theory. Exhaustive adjacency-preserving backtracking enumerates 48 automorphisms, two signed face-trace calculations agree, the Hopf formula yields every displayed character entry, central + and - character squared inner products are each one, and transfer gives rational acyclicity of the orbit quotient. A separate mod-two boundary rank check corroborates the ranks without being used as an integral proof. The source code and exact results are supplied.

value.rationale: The Franklin graph is the canonical 12-vertex cubic Klein-bottle graph. Parameter-two higher independence is its natural dissociation complex. The joint integral sphere-wedge classification and full 48-automorphism character reveal a nontrivial 3-plus-2 decomposition into absolutely irreducible symmetry modules with zero global invariants; these structural facts are neither routine graph-parameter computations nor consequences of known edge-matching or cardinality-only dissociation results. The exact natural finite object provides a benchmark for topology of nonchordal cubic graph higher-independence complexes.
